jobs.title: Senior Associate Director: Project Design and Engineering - Ports & Maritime
jobs.description:
Location

Glasgow, Lanarkshire, United Kingdom

Capabilities

Civil and Structural

Office Setup

Hybrid

Job ID

#46165

  

Industry

Water

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

  

**Shape the future of maritime infrastructure.**

  
  

➡️ This is more than a leadership role. It's an opportunity to influence some of the most complex and high-profile port, coastal and marine projects across the UK and around the world.

➡️ Joining our growing Ports & Maritime team, you'll help clients tackle some of today's biggest obstacles, from decarbonisation and climate resilience to the modernisation of critical infrastructure. Your expertise will directly support the movement of goods, the security of nations, the transition to cleaner energy, and the long-term sustainability of coastal communities.

➡️ As a recognised technical specialist, you'll help define solutions, develop talent, strengthen client partnerships, and shape the future direction of our maritime business.

  
  

**What's In It For You**

  
  

We're committed to creating an environment where talented people can do their best work and build exceptional careers.

  
  

*You'll benefit from:*

The opportunity to lead major UK and international maritime programmes with industry-pioneering clients

A clear pathway to further senior management and development opportunities within a globally recognised consultancy

Access to a worldwide network of 750+ maritime specialists and technical experts

The chance to influence business growth, strategy and capability development

Flexible and hybrid working options that support work-life balance

Exposure to complex, technically taxing projects that will stretch and develop your expertise

A culture that values collaboration, innovation, mentoring and continuous learning

The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to sustainable infrastructure and net-zero objectives

  
  

**We Offer**

  
  

Compensation that reflects your skills and experience

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

️ 24 days annual leave plus the option to buy up to 10 additional days

Enhanced pension contributions of up to 10%

* ️ Private medical cover and Digital GP access

‍ ‍

Family planning and fertility support services

Enhanced parental leave and family support programmes

Employee Networks: We have a commitment to hiring a diverse workforce and supporting colleagues of different backgrounds

️ Life assurance at four times your salary

Income protection for long-term financial security

Access to wellbeing support, including Calm and Daily Burn

Professional memberships funded and ongoing development opportunities

Paid volunteering time, matched charity funding, and community engagement programmes

  
  

**About the Opportunity**

  
  

Our UK Ports & Maritime team comprises more than 100 specialists and forms part of a global network delivering innovative engineering solutions across ports, bulk terminals, naval facilities, coastal defences, marine infrastructure, dredging and reclamation projects.

  
  

Due to continued **investment** and **strong growth**, we're expanding our leadership team and looking for an experienced maritime professional who can help drive the next phase of our success.

  
  

In this role, you'll provide **technical** and **programme stewardship** across multidisciplinary projects, guiding teams from concept and FEED through design, procurement, construction and asset support.

  
  

*You'll:*

* ️ Lead the delivery of complex maritime engineering programmes

* ️ Provide expert technical guidance and act as a trusted advisor to clients and project teams

* ️ Manage multidisciplinary and multi-office teams to deliver quality outcomes safely, on time and within budget

* ️ Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities to create additional value

* ️ Champion innovation, digital delivery and collaborative working practices

* ️ Drive effective risk, change and programme management

* ️ Mentor and develop future leaders within the business

* ️ Promote a strong safety culture across every stage of project delivery

  
  

**This is a unique opportunity to combine technical excellence, strategic leadership and business influence within one of the industry's most respected maritime teams.**

  

Here's what you'll need

  

We're looking for an established maritime leader who brings:

✅ Chartered Engineer status

✅ Significant experience spearheading complex maritime engineering projects and programmes

✅ A successful track record managing multidisciplinary teams across multiple locations

✅ Experience delivering projects through the full lifecycle, from FEED and design through to construction and operational support

✅ Strong stakeholder and client relationship management skills

✅ Commercial awareness, including financial, contractual and change management expertise

✅ A passion for developing people through mentoring, coaching and knowledge sharing

  
  

**Ready to Leave Your Mark?**

  
  

If you're looking for a role where your leadership will shape major infrastructure, influence pioneering projects, and create lasting impact across the maritime sector, we'd love to hear from you.

  
  

Join us and help deliver the next generation of ports, coastal infrastructure and maritime solutions that will serve communities, industries and future generations for decades to come.

  
  

**Apply today and be part of what's next.**

  
  

️ Jacobs offers hybrid working and a standard 40-hour working week

  
  

Good luck with your application

  
  

#LI-EG1 #LI-HYBRID

Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.

  
  

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.

  

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

  

Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https://www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.

  

As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

jobs.title: Apps Dev Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an exceptional, high-caliber **Senior Software Engineer / Developer** to join our **Commodities Technology** team based in **London**. Sitting at the intersection of quantitative and high-performance software engineering, this role is dedicated to delivering mission-critical market data infrastructure, services, and analytics feeds for our global Commodities trading desks.

As a senior individual contributor in a front-office environment, you will drive the architecture, design, and implementation of robust, low-latency market data pipelines and services across Commodities asset classes (Energy, Metals, Agriculture) with cross-asset touchpoints in FX, Rates, and Equities. You will partner directly with Front Office Traders, Model Quantitative Analysis (MQA / Quants), Market Risk, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions and integrate next-generation Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows into the development and trading lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. System Engineering & Architecture**

* Architect, build, and optimize scalable, resilient, and high-throughput market data engines, curve builders, pricing integration layers, and real-time distribution services.
* Design and implement clean, modular APIs and event-driven architectures leveraging modern design patterns across **Java, Python, or .NET (C#)** ecosystems.
* Ensure ultra-reliable delivery of tick, end-of-day, and historical market data feeds to quantitative pricing libraries and trading applications.

**2. Front Office & Desk Alignment**

* Act as a direct technical partner to Front Office trading desks, understanding business drivers and rapidly translating complex trading/pricing requirements into production-ready software.
* Collaborate closely with **MQA (Quantitative Analysts)** to integrate pricing models, risk calculators, and real-time analytics.

**3. AI & Innovation Driver**

* Champion the adoption of **Generative AI** and **Agentic AI** frameworks within the software development lifecycle (e.g., automated code reviews, synthesis, workflow orchestration, agent-driven monitoring/troubleshooting).
* Prototype and evaluate agentic workflows for automated anomaly detection, market data quality validation, and intelligent developer tooling.

**4. Technical Leadership & Excellence**

* Drive engineering best practices: test-driven development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, comprehensive observability, and low-latency performance tuning.
* Take end-to-end ownership of delivery—from requirement analysis and technical design to deployment, production monitoring, and support.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Core Programming:** Advanced proficiency in at least one primary backend language:
  + **Java** (Modern Java, Spring Boot, concurrency, low-latency tuning, GC optimization), OR
  + **Python** (Modern Python, asynchronous programming, NumPy/Pandas, FastAPI), OR
  + **.NET / C#** (Modern .NET Core, multi-threading, asynchronous I/O, memory profiling).
* **Distributed Systems & Messaging:** Strong experience with enterprise messaging and streaming frameworks (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Solace, ZeroMQ, or gRPC).
* **Data Storage & Analytics:** Proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and time-series/caching technologies (e.g., Redis, InfluxDB, KDB+/q, or similar).
* **Modern DevOps & Cloud:** Practical experience with Git, CI/CD automation (e.g., GitHub , Tekton, Jenkins), Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift, and Linux operating systems.
* **AI Tooling & Automation:** Demonstrated familiarity with LLMs, GenAI tools, and Agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP tools, automated coding agents) applied to engineering productivity or domain solutions.

**Domain & Industry Experience**

* **Financial Services Experience:** Proven track record working within a Tier-1 investment bank, hedge fund, or major financial institution.
* **Asset Class Expertise:** Strong domain knowledge in **Commodities** (Power, Gas, Oil, Metals, Agriculture) or adjacent cross-asset products (**FX, Rates, Equities**).
* **Market Data Fundamentals:** Understanding of real-time market data structures, tick data, exchange connectivity, forward curves, volatilities, and reference data feeds.
  

  

**Mindset & Behavioral Attributes**

* **Self-Driven & High Ownership:** A true "go-getter" who takes proactive ownership of complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to converse fluently with traders, MQA, risk managers, and technology leaders.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-stakes Front Office environment where requirements evolve rapidly.
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred
  

  

**What we can offer you**

We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we put our employees first and provide the best-in-class benefits they need to be well, live well and save well.

  
  

By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:

* Generous holiday allowance starting at 27 days plus bank holidays; increasing with tenure
* A discretional annual performance related bonus
* Private medical insurance packages to suit your personal circumstances
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pension Plan
* Paid Parental Leave
* Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
* Access to an array of learning and development resources
  

  

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

  
  

**Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2
jobs.description:
**About Cencora**
-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Software Engineer 2**

Remote - Poland *Optional office base in Lublin*

We’re looking for a Software Engineer 2 to join our growing engineering team in Poland and help build secure, high-quality software for the Pharmaceutical Trial Master File (TMF) industry.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a developer who is ready to take the next step - someone who can work independently, contribute to solution design, and help shape how modern software is built in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

You’ll be part of a new team creating software for a specialist pharmaceutical domain, with the chance to use modern AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude as part of everyday delivery.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Fixing moderately complex bugs in familiar code and tackling basic issues in unfamiliar code.
* Building new functionality independently with architectural guidance where needed.
* Developing with .NET and C#, applying SOLID principles, design patterns and dependency injection.
* Writing reliable unit tests and contributing to strong engineering quality standards.
* Using AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while critically reviewing code for quality, security and correctness.
* Collaborating with testers and DevOps, contributing to sprint planning, and helping solve support issues at the root cause.
* Mentoring more junior developers and supporting high coding standards across the team.
* Building your knowledge of the Pharmaceutical TMF domain and applying it in real solutions for clients.

#LI-AT2

.

**What we’re looking for**

* 3+ years of software development experience.
* Strong experience with Microsoft .NET / C#.
* Experience with unit testing, dependency injection, and REST web services.
* Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, Azure SQL or MySQL.
* Exposure to web UI development such as React, Angular or jQuery.
* Confidence using AI-assisted coding tools with a critical eye on output quality and security.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach.

**Why join us**

* Remote role based in Poland.
* Lublin office available if you’d like to work from there - but it’s not a requirement.
* A chance to join a new engineering team and make a visible impact as it grows.
* Opportunity to work in a specialist pharmaceutical technology space with plenty of room to learn and grow.
* Preferred knowledge of GCP and/or TMF is helpful, but not essential.

If you’re a software engineer who enjoys solving problems, writing quality code and working with modern tools in a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

**What Cencora offers**

Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.

Full time
